cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(needle_cpu LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Needle CPU targets 64-bit platforms only")
endif()
option(NEEDLE_CPU_ENABLE_SIMD "Build hardware-dispatched SIMD kernels" ON)
option(NEEDLE_CPU_SHARED "Build a shared runtime" ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(needle_options INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(needle_options INTERFACE Threads::Threads)
target_include_directories(needle_options INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(needle_options INTERFACE /O2 /W4 /fp:strict)
else()
  target_compile_options(needle_options INTERFACE -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -ffp-contract=off)
endif()
include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)
if(APPLE)
  find_library(ACCELERATE Accelerate REQUIRED)
  # The new CBLAS symbols require iOS 16.4. Use the legacy ABI for iOS 15.
  if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS")
    target_compile_definitions(needle_options INTERFACE ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK)
    set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_DEFINITIONS -DACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK)
  else()
    target_compile_options(needle_options INTERFACE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
  endif()
  target_link_libraries(needle_options INTERFACE ${ACCELERATE})
  set(NEEDLE_BLAS_HEADER "Accelerate/Accelerate.h")
  set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES ${ACCELERATE})
  target_compile_definitions(needle_options INTERFACE NEEDLE_BLAS_NAME="accelerate")
else()
  # FindBLAS alone does not promise the CBLAS header or C entry points.
  set(BLA_VENDOR OpenBLAS)
  set(BLA_SIZEOF_INTEGER 4)
  set(NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Pinned single-threaded OpenBLAS installation")
  if(NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_ROOT)
    find_path(CBLAS_INCLUDE_DIR cblas.h PATHS "${NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_ROOT}/include" PATH_SUFFIXES openblas NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH REQUIRED)
    find_library(NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_LIBRARY NAMES openblas PATHS "${NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_ROOT}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH REQUIRED)
    add_library(needle_blas INTERFACE)
    target_link_libraries(needle_blas INTERFACE ${NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_LIBRARY})
    set(NEEDLE_BLAS_TARGET needle_blas)
  else()
    find_package(BLAS REQUIRED)
    find_path(CBLAS_INCLUDE_DIR cblas.h PATH_SUFFIXES openblas REQUIRED)
    set(NEEDLE_BLAS_TARGET BLAS::BLAS)
  endif()
  target_include_directories(needle_options INTERFACE ${CBLAS_INCLUDE_DIR})
  target_link_libraries(needle_options INTERFACE ${NEEDLE_BLAS_TARGET})
  set(NEEDLE_BLAS_HEADER "cblas.h")
  set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_INCLUDES ${CBLAS_INCLUDE_DIR})
  # A check's try_compile project cannot see a non-imported interface target.
  if(NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_ROOT)
    set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES ${NEEDLE_OPENBLAS_LIBRARY} Threads::Threads)
  else()
    set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES BLAS::BLAS)
  endif()
  target_compile_definitions(needle_options INTERFACE NEEDLE_BLAS_NAME="openblas")
endif()
check_cxx_source_compiles("#include <${NEEDLE_BLAS_HEADER}>
#include <type_traits>
using NeedleGemm = void (*)(CBLAS_ORDER,CBLAS_TRANSPOSE,CBLAS_TRANSPOSE,int,int,int,float,const float*,int,const float*,int,float,float*,int);
static_assert(std::is_same<decltype(&cblas_sgemm),NeedleGemm>::value);
int main() { float x[4]={}; cblas_sgemm(CblasRowMajor,CblasNoTrans,CblasNoTrans,1,1,1,1,x,1,x,1,0,x,1); cblas_sgemv(CblasRowMajor,CblasNoTrans,1,1,1,x,1,x,1,0,x,1); }" NEEDLE_HAS_LP64_CBLAS)
if(NOT NEEDLE_HAS_LP64_CBLAS)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Needle requires LP64 CBLAS headers and sgemm/sgemv symbols")
endif()
set(NEEDLE_KERNELS kernels.cpp kernels_scalar.cpp)
set(NEEDLE_ARCH "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
if(APPLE AND CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
  set(NEEDLE_ARCH "${CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES}")
endif()
set(NEEDLE_CPU_EXPECT_ARCH "" CACHE STRING "Expected target: x86_64 or arm64")
if(NEEDLE_CPU_EXPECT_ARCH STREQUAL "x86_64" AND NOT NEEDLE_ARCH MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64)$")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This preset requires an x86-64 toolchain")
elseif(NEEDLE_CPU_EXPECT_ARCH STREQUAL "arm64" AND NOT NEEDLE_ARCH MATCHES "^(arm64|aarch64|ARM64)$")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This preset requires an ARM64 toolchain")
endif()
if(NEEDLE_CPU_ENABLE_SIMD)
  if(NEEDLE_ARCH MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64)$")
    list(APPEND NEEDLE_KERNELS kernels_sse2.cpp kernels_avx2.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(needle_options INTERFACE NEEDLE_HAVE_X86)
    if(MSVC)
      set_source_files_properties(kernels_avx2.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/arch:AVX2")
    else()
      set_source_files_properties(kernels_sse2.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-msse2;-mno-avx")
      set_source_files_properties(kernels_avx2.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx2;-mno-fma")
    endif()
  elseif(NEEDLE_ARCH MATCHES "^(arm64|aarch64|ARM64)$")
    list(APPEND NEEDLE_KERNELS kernels_neon.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(needle_options INTERFACE NEEDLE_HAVE_NEON)
    include(CheckCXXCompilerFlag)
    check_cxx_compiler_flag("-march=armv8.2-a+dotprod" NEEDLE_CAN_BUILD_DOTPROD)
    if(NEEDLE_CAN_BUILD_DOTPROD)
      list(APPEND NEEDLE_KERNELS kernels_neon_dot.cpp)
      set_source_files_properties(kernels_neon_dot.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-march=armv8.2-a+dotprod")
      target_compile_definitions(needle_options INTERFACE NEEDLE_HAVE_NEON_DOT)
    endif()
  endif()
endif()
# The diagnostic baseline must not be silently vectorized by the compiler.
if(MSVC)
  set_source_files_properties(kernels_scalar.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/Qvec-")
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  set_source_files_properties(kernels_scalar.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fno-vectorize;-fno-slp-vectorize")
else()
  set_source_files_properties(kernels_scalar.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fno-tree-vectorize")
endif()
set(NEEDLE_SOURCES archive.cpp math.cpp cq4.cpp workers.cpp decoder.cpp confidence.cpp generation.cpp fusion.cpp representation.cpp api.cpp ${NEEDLE_KERNELS})
if(NEEDLE_CPU_SHARED)
  add_library(needle_cpu SHARED ${NEEDLE_SOURCES})
else()
  add_library(needle_cpu STATIC ${NEEDLE_SOURCES})
  target_compile_definitions(needle_cpu PUBLIC NEEDLE_CPU_STATIC)
endif()
target_link_libraries(needle_cpu PRIVATE needle_options)
target_include_directories(needle_cpu PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(needle_cpu PRIVATE NEEDLE_CPU_BUILD)
set_target_properties(needle_cpu PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES
  INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION FALSE POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE YES)
if(ANDROID)
  target_link_options(needle_cpu PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384")
endif()
install(TARGETS needle_cpu LIBRARY DESTINATION lib ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES needle.h DESTINATION include)
